name: board-viewer
title: Board format (board@1)
description: The board@1 format a PM agent writes as *.board.json: a strict parser that reports every problem (unversioned, newer or invalid files included), the planner that lays maquette screens and HTML mock-ups out left to right with goto arrows and notes, and the edit round-trip that writes frame moves and notes back into the board file. Plain data and pure functions: no canvas, no rendering, no storage.
